raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions ignores raw_transactions.currency, so 85 EUR rows are summed as if they were USD. raw_fx_rates has a single static EUR rate (1.25, as_of 2026-01-01, before all transactions), so I convert amounts to USD in silver and the gold tables follow.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(ROUND(t.amount * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = t.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
